name: panel-packing-32k-size-conflict
hypothesis: Cannot implement the selected layout as specified. A dense 32-row panel across K=512 requires 512*32*4 = 65536 bytes (64 KiB), twice the requested 32 KiB. The specified packed_a[k*32+r] accesses float index 16383, beyond a 32 KiB allocation. A 32 KiB buffer would require changing the panel dimensions or splitting K, which changes the selected experiment. The prior measured one-SME-region panel32 candidate already uses a 64 KiB buffer and sixteen 32-row bands; it failed promotion. No substitute, source edits, tests or measurements were performed.
